title: Vlax Romani language - Wikipedia
text: Vlax Romani is written using the Romani orthography, predominantly using the Latin alphabet with several additional characters. In the area of the former Soviet Union, however, it can also be written in the Cyrillic script.

title: Romani language - Wikipedia
text: There are efforts to teach and familiarise Vlax-Romani to a new generation of Romani so that Romani spoken in different parts of the world are connected through a single dialect of Romani.

title: Vlax Rroma Music - rroma.org
text: On the one hand, there is the Romanian “lautari” music, with cymbalum, violin, etc. prevalent in Romania and Transilvania, the music of the Vojvodina, with its characteristic 4 stringed guitars, and finally the Hungarian Vlax Rroma music, with guitar and oral bass.

title: Romani Music in Hungary - RomArchive
text: “Oral bass” and oral percussion (akin to Indian drum syllables) are still very common, and it could be argued that they are a unique feature of Romani music, especially among Hungarian Lovara and other Vlax Roma.

title: Music - RomArchive
text: The Flamenco section highlights the great contribution made by Roma people to the creation and development of this music, which has given rise to a hugely valuable musical, cultural and ethnological legacy: Flamenco Gitano.

title: Romani music — Grokipedia
text: Romani musicians entered Europe in significant numbers during the 15th century, following migrations from the Byzantine and Ottoman territories, where they had already adapted performance practices to local contexts.
